items.title: The growing problem stopping Melbourne residents using their microwaves
items.description: A power company warns that growing electricity demand is creating an undervoltage issue as Victoria's infrastructure struggles to keep up with the transition from gas.

items.title: Remote residents 'cooking from the inside' sue NT government
items.description: Residents of the Central Australian community of Papunya say the scorching hot outback summers are killing their people in unsafe housing. Now they’re suing the Northern Territory government to try to force change.

items.title: 500,000 Australians wait for end to 'limbo' as Butler readies NDIS plan

items.title: In a split second, Keelie made the 'surreal' decision to reveal her abuse

items.title: Dispute leaves devastated home owners stuck in 'limbo'

items.title: Live: ASX set to drop, markets on edge as Trump extends ceasefire
items.description: Renewed concerns about the Middle East war have outweighed initial optimism over a round of solid corporate earnings despite President Donald Trump extending the ceasefire. Follow live.

items.title: Carpooling an 'effective solution' to fuel prices, so why aren't more doing it?
items.description: Despite fuel prices soaring in March, the number of vehicles travelling along a key carpooling lane in Sydney increased by just 1 per cent. A transport expert says more needs to be done to encourage people to share their commutes.

items.title: Chocolate-box violin inspires teen to retrace relative's Anzac footsteps

items.title: US authorities probe possible ChatGPT involvement in university shooting

items.title: Breaking: New era starts as Maroons name side for Women's Origin I
